page.content:
The sushi chef behind the counter — board, knife, and hospitality.

How Itamae connects

  • Topic: Edomae sushi — The itamae is the craftsperson who runs an Edomae counter.
  • Topic: Omakase — Omakase leaves the sequence of nigiri to the itamae.

What is Itamae?

Itamae means the person at the cutting board. In sushi, it is the craft identity: rice, fish, timing, and the talk across the hinoki.

Key threads lead to Edomae sushi and Omakase.
